translations.web: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.
translations.bsb: Whoever keeps the whole law but stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.
translations.kjv: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
translations.asv: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet stumble in one point, he is become guilty of all.
